findings.description: Argument.get_help_record now returns (metavar, self.help) even when help is None, contradicting its docstring's promise of an empty description. Callers such as format_options pass that None into write_dl, which will fail.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one positional argument that has help text and another positional argument with no help. format_options sees any(arg.help is not None) is true and builds records including (metavar, None) for the undocumented argument. write_dl then calls text wrapping on None (e.g. text.expandtabs()), raising AttributeError. The user sees a crash when running --help on a common command shape, where previously the undocumented argument was simply omitted.
